description: Seeded SQLite Text-to-SQL cases for deterministic pipeline and retrieval validation.

cases.question: How many orders are there for each status?
cases.expected_answer: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 100

cases.question: What is the gross revenue for each month?
cases.expected_answer: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS order_month, SUM(oi.line_total_cents) AS gross_revenue_cents FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi USING (order_id) GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY order_month LIMIT 100

cases.question: Show monthly sales by product.
cases.expected_answer: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS order_month, p.product_name, SUM(oi.line_total_cents) AS gross_revenue_cents FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi USING (order_id) JOIN products AS p USING (product_id) GROUP BY order_month, p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY order_month, gross_revenue_cents DESC LIMIT 100

cases.question: What are the top 10 products by gross revenue?
cases.expected_answer: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.line_total_cents) AS gross_revenue_cents FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p USING (product_id) GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY gross_revenue_cents DESC LIMIT 10

cases.question: List customers with their order dates and totals.
cases.expected_answer: SELECT c.full_name, o.order_date, o.total_amount_cents FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o USING (customer_id) ORDER BY o.order_date DESC LIMIT 100

cases.question: What is the average order value for each customer region?
cases.expected_answer: SELECT c.region, AVG(o.total_amount_cents) AS average_order_cents FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o USING (customer_id) GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY average_order_cents DESC LIMIT 100

cases.question: How many orders were placed last month?
cases.expected_answer: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= date('now', 'start of month', '-1 month') AND order_date < date('now', 'start of month') LIMIT 100

cases.question: Show delivery times by shipment date for delivered shipments.
cases.expected_answer: SELECT o.order_id, s.shipped_at, s.delivered_at, julianday(s.delivered_at) - julianday(s.shipped_at) AS delivery_days FROM shipments AS s JOIN orders AS o USING (order_id) WHERE s.status = 'delivered' ORDER BY delivery_days DESC LIMIT 100

cases.question: List products and categories together, showing each product name with its category name.
cases.expected_answer: SELECT p.product_name, c.name AS category_name FROM products AS p JOIN categories AS c USING (category_id) ORDER BY c.name, p.product_name LIMIT 100

cases.question: How many customers are there in each country?
cases.expected_answer: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 100

cases.question: How many products are there in each category?
cases.expected_answer: SELECT c.name AS category_name, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM categories AS c JOIN products AS p USING (category_id) GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT 100

cases.question: Show total quantity sold for each product name.
cases.expected_answer: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi USING (product_id) GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 100

cases.question: Which category brings in the most revenue?
cases.expected_answer: SELECT c.name AS category_name, SUM(oi.line_total_cents) AS gross_revenue_cents FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p USING (product_id) JOIN categories AS c USING (category_id) GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY gross_revenue_cents DESC LIMIT 100

cases.question: How many orders do we have in total?
cases.expected_answer: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders LIMIT 100

cases.question: List all category names.
cases.expected_answer: SELECT name, description FROM categories ORDER BY name LIMIT 100

cases.question: List the ten products with the highest unit price.
cases.expected_answer: SELECT product_name, unit_price_cents FROM products ORDER BY unit_price_cents DESC LIMIT 10

cases.question: Show me the cancelled orders.
cases.expected_answer: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, total_amount_cents FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' ORDER BY order_date DESC LIMIT 100

cases.question: What is the total amount refunded?
cases.expected_answer: SELECT SUM(amount_cents) AS refunded_cents FROM payments WHERE payment_type = 'refund' LIMIT 100

cases.question: How much was charged by each payment method?
cases.expected_answer: SELECT payment_method, SUM(amount_cents) AS charged_cents FROM payments WHERE payment_type = 'charge' GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY charged_cents DESC LIMIT 100

cases.question: Who are our top 10 customers by total spend?
cases.expected_answer: SELECT c.full_name, SUM(o.total_amount_cents) AS total_spend_cents FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o USING (customer_id) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name ORDER BY total_spend_cents DESC LIMIT 10

cases.question: List refund payments together with the status of their orders.
cases.expected_answer: SELECT p.payment_id, o.order_id, o.status, p.amount_cents, p.paid_at FROM payments AS p JOIN orders AS o USING (order_id) WHERE p.payment_type = 'refund' ORDER BY p.paid_at DESC LIMIT 100

cases.question: Show order line items with the product name and quantity.
cases.expected_answer: SELECT oi.order_id, p.product_name, oi.quantity, oi.line_total_cents FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p USING (product_id) ORDER BY oi.order_id LIMIT 100

cases.question: How many orders were placed in each year?
cases.expected_answer: SELECT strftime('%Y', order_date) AS order_year, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY order_year ORDER BY order_year LIMIT 100

cases.question: What is the average delivery time in days for each carrier?
cases.expected_answer: SELECT carrier, AVG(julianday(delivered_at) - julianday(shipped_at)) AS average_delivery_days FROM shipments WHERE status = 'delivered' GROUP BY carrier ORDER BY average_delivery_days LIMIT 100

cases.question: How many new customers signed up in each month?
cases.expected_answer: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', signup_date) AS signup_month, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY signup_month ORDER BY signup_month LIMIT 100
